lines.tts: Hi, Melbourne!
lines.sub: Hi, Melbourne!

lines.tts: We're Group 14, Team Sweet Potatoes, and this is Potato, the Public Opinion Translation And Tracking Outpost.
lines.sub: We're Group 14, Team Sweet Potatoes, and this is POTATO — the Public Opinion Translation And Tracking Outpost.

lines.tts: Why potato?
lines.sub: Why POTATO?

lines.tts: Because, like a sweet potato, good ideas grow from the ground up.
lines.sub: Because, like a sweet potato, good ideas grow from the ground up.

lines.tts: Melbourne's councils make decisions about parks, housing and transport.
lines.sub: Melbourne's councils make decisions about parks, housing and transport.

lines.tts: Our fieldwork with eight international residents found the barrier isn't a lack of interest.
lines.sub: Our fieldwork with eight international residents found the barrier isn't a lack of interest.

lines.tts: People can't find relevant information.
lines.sub: People can't find relevant information.

lines.tts: Translated policies still use terms they don't understand.
lines.sub: Translated policies still use terms they don't understand.

lines.tts: And they don't know where their feedback goes.
lines.sub: And they don't know where their feedback goes.

lines.tts: Meanwhile, council news arrives by mail and flyers, but newer residents live on Instagram.
lines.sub: Meanwhile, council news arrives by mail and flyers, but newer residents live on Instagram.

lines.tts: Meet Jason.
lines.sub: Meet Jason.

lines.tts: He's lived in Melbourne for years, but English isn't his first language.
lines.sub: He's lived in Melbourne for years, but English isn't his first language.

lines.tts: He's unhappy about a new park rule for dogs, yet he doesn't know who to tell, or which words to use.
lines.sub: He's unhappy about a new park rule for dogs, yet he doesn't know who to tell, or which words to use.

lines.tts: On his grocery walk, Jason passes a Potato post.
lines.sub: On his grocery walk, Jason passes a POTATO post.

lines.tts: Its screen shows verified council and community notices, so he finds things he'd never see in the mail.
lines.sub: Its screen shows verified council and community notices, so he finds things he'd never see in the mail.

lines.tts: Then Spud, our mascot, greets him and lists the issues closest to this spot, ranked by distance and closing date.
lines.sub: Then Spud, our mascot, greets him and lists the issues closest to this spot, ranked by distance and closing date.

lines.tts: Jason taps the park issue.
lines.sub: Jason taps the park issue.

lines.tts: A plain-language summary appears in his own language, with difficult terms explained.
lines.sub: A plain-language summary appears in his own language, with difficult terms explained.

lines.tts: Now he simply talks to Spud, in his own language.
lines.sub: Now he simply talks to Spud, in his own language.

lines.tts: 新的公園規定讓遛狗變得很不方便，我希望可以重新考慮。
lines.sub: The new park rule makes walking my dog really inconvenient. I hope it can be reconsidered.

lines.tts: Spud turns that into a structured comment, original Chinese plus English, names the responsible department, and lets Jason review and edit before sending.
lines.sub: Spud turns that into a structured comment, original Chinese plus English, names the responsible department, and lets Jason review and edit before sending.

lines.tts: No audio is stored.
lines.sub: No audio is stored.

lines.tts: Jason taps his phone on the N F C pad.
lines.sub: Jason taps his phone on the NFC pad.

lines.tts: The issue and his comment move to the Potato app, and the post keeps nothing.
lines.sub: The issue and his comment move to the POTATO app, and the post keeps nothing.

lines.tts: Tracking begins only because Jason chose it.
lines.sub: Tracking begins only because Jason chose it.

lines.tts: The app shows each stage: Received, In review, then an outcome with a case number, or reasons if declined.
lines.sub: The app shows each stage: Received, In review, then an outcome with a case number, or reasons if declined.

lines.tts: Notifications keep him updated.
lines.sub: Notifications keep him updated.

lines.tts: Not sure who to ask?
lines.sub: Not sure who to ask?

lines.tts: The Q and A assistant answers from official documents, cites its sources, and hands over to a named contact when it's unsure.
lines.sub: The Q&A assistant answers from official documents, cites its sources, and hands over to a named contact when it's unsure.

lines.tts: And one tap shares a card on Instagram, so Jason's neighbours can join in.
lines.sub: And one tap shares a card on Instagram, so Jason's neighbours can join in.

lines.tts: For Jason, that means finding relevant issues on his everyday route, understanding them in his own language, knowing which department hears him, and seeing what happens next.
lines.sub: For Jason, that means finding relevant issues on his everyday route, understanding them in his own language, knowing which department hears him, and seeing what happens next.

lines.tts: All without attending a meeting.
lines.sub: All without attending a meeting.

lines.tts: Potato has limits.
lines.sub: POTATO has limits.

lines.tts: Speaking in public may feel exposing, AI can mistranslate, and our fieldwork didn't include council staff.
lines.sub: Speaking in public may feel exposing, AI can mistranslate, and our fieldwork didn't include council staff.

lines.tts: Next, we'll test a low-fidelity prototype with residents across languages, and check whether they trust and correct the AI's output.
lines.sub: Next, we'll test a low-fidelity prototype with residents across languages, and check whether they trust and correct the AI's output.

lines.tts: Potato: Public Opinion Translation And Tracking Outpost.
lines.sub: POTATO: Public Opinion Translation And Tracking Outpost.

lines.tts: Voices from the ground up.
lines.sub: Voices from the ground up.
